site.name: Alabama Shaft
overview: Alabama Shaft is a documented historic gold-silver shaft and mine locality in Clear Creek County's Lamartine Mining District.

USGS-derived topographic mapping preserves the named shaft near 39.73721, -105.58667, providing a defensible mine-level identification anchor without asserting that any historic surface structure survives today.
moreHistory: Federal mine inventories preserve Alabama Shaft as a named past-producing Clear Creek County locality. The mapped point identifies the historic shaft property; Remnant does not claim that the shaft collar, a headframe, hoist house, ore bins, or other surface remains have been field-verified or are accessible.
A focused exact-site media search did not produce a defensible reusable historical photograph, so unrelated district imagery was rejected rather than attached to the wrong site.
